This petition coming on for admission this day, the cour  following:

ORDER By way of this petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, the petitioner is raising a grievance in respect of the award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer whereunder the land of the petitioner has been acquired.
However, compensation has not been awarded to him, according to the petitioner, it has been awarded to the earlier land owner from whom petitioner has purchased the land.

2. Counsel for the petitioner further submits that on the date of notification of acquiring the land,
the petitioner was the recorded owner of the land despite that compensation has not been awarded Dharmendra Mishra vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69452686/
2 to him.

sentences.text: He raised an objection before the Land Acquisition Officer and his objection was rejected by the Collector vide order dated 12.11.2022.

Now the only remedy available to the petitioner to claim compensation as he was the person entitled to receive the same make a reference under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and if, the application in this regard is made, the Collector shall make a reference to the Competent Court within a period period of 60 days from the date of submitting the application.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. However, Counsel for the petitioner may also move an appropriate application before the reference court for injunction or for not disbursing the amount of compensation.
If the same is done, the reference court will also decide the said application expeditiously.
4. With the aforesaid, this petition is disposed of.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE rk.
